<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" name="viewport"/>
<meta content="#fffaf3" name="theme-color"/>
<title>By Souhair Shaar • Alphabet Adventure</title>
<style>
:root{
--ink:#273247;
--muted:#68738a;
--paper:#fffdf8;
--cream:#fff6e8;
--line:#eadfce;
--shadow:0 18px 45px rgba(44,52,67,.10),0 4px 12px rgba(44,52,67,.07);
--shadow-sm:0 10px 24px rgba(44,52,67,.09),0 2px 7px rgba(44,52,67,.06);
--radius-xl:30px;
--radius-lg:22px;
--radius-md:16px;
--accent:#ff7a7a;
--accent-2:#ffb86b;
--accent-soft:#fff0ee;
--good:#3a9f72;
--good-soft:#eaf7f0;
--bad:#d85c5c;
--bad-soft:#fff0f0;
--blue:#6da7e8;
--purple:#9277d8;
--yellow:#f4c95d;
font-synthesis:none;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;min-height:100%;background:#f7f0e6}
body{
font-family:ui-rounded,"SF Pro Rounded","Segoe UI",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;
color:var(--ink);
min-height:100vh;
overflow-x:hidden;
background:
radial-gradient(circle at 10% 0%,rgba(255,255,255,.9) 0 120px,transparent 260px),
radial-gradient(circle at 90% 8%,rgba(255,233,200,.85) 0 100px,transparent 220px),
linear-gradient(180deg,#fffaf2 0%,#f8f1e7 100%);
}
button{font:inherit}
button,.clickable{ -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent }
button:focus-visible,.clickable:focus-visible{outline:4px solid rgba(109,167,232,.35);outline-offset:3px}
.app-shell{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:18px 18px 44px;position:relative}
.topbar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;margin:4px 0 16px;position:relative}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;cursor:pointer;border:0;background:none;padding:4px;min-width:220px}
.brand-mark{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:14px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(50,60,80,.15);overflow:hidden;padding:5px;flex:none}
.school-brand-mark img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;display:block}
.brand-copy strong{display:block;font-size:20px;line-height:1.05;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.brand-copy span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;margin-top:3px;font-weight:800}
.topbar-greeting{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;white-space:nowrap;color:var(--accent);font-size:16px;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:none;pointer-events:none}
.topbar-greeting:before{content:"👋";font-size:17px}
.topbar-greeting[hidden]{display:none}
.toolbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end}
.voice-toggle{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.82);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:4px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm)}
.voice-label{font-size:10px;font-weight:900;color:var(--muted);padding:0 5px 0 7px;white-space:nowrap}
.voice-choice{border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;font-weight:900;border-radius:10px;padding:8px 9px;cursor:pointer;transition:.16s ease;white-space:nowrap}
.voice-choice.active{background:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.voice-choice:hover{background:#f5efe7;color:var(--ink)}
.voice-choice.active:hover{background:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.icon-btn{border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.82);width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:13px;cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--ink);box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);transition:.18s ease}
.icon-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);background:#fff}
.icon-btn.active{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;border-color:var(--ink)}
.screen{display:none;animation:screenIn .28s ease}
.screen.active{display:block}
@keyframes screenIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
/* Student start dialog */
.start-dialog{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:10000;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:24px;background:rgba(39,50,71,.34);backdrop-filter:blur(7px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(7px);animation:dialogFade .2s ease}
.start-dialog[hidden]{display:none}
.start-dialog-card{width:min(560px,100%);background:rgba(255,253,248,.98);border:1px solid rgba(234,223,206,.95);border-radius:32px;box-shadow:0 28px 80px rgba(39,50,71,.24);padding:30px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;animation:dialogCardIn .24s ease both}
.start-dialog-card:before{content:"";position:absolute;width:190px;height:190px;border-radius:50%;background:#ffe7c5;right:-85px;top:-100px;pointer-events:none}
.start-dialog-card:after{content:"";position:absolute;width:140px;height:140px;border-radius:50%;background:#e4f4ff;left:-75px;bottom:-85px;pointer-events:none}
.start-dialog-content{position:relative;z-index:1}
.start-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-bottom:22px}
.start-brand-mark{width:62px;height:62px;border-radius:20px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 12px 24px rgba(50,60,80,.15);flex:none;overflow:hidden;padding:7px}
.start-brand-logo{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;display:block}
.start-brand-copy strong{display:block;font-size:28px;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.035em}
.start-brand-copy span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;font-weight:900;margin-top:5px;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase}
.start-welcome{font-size:13px;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:7px}
.start-dialog h2{margin:0;font-size:clamp(30px,6vw,43px);letter-spacing:-.04em;line-height:1}
.start-teacher{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;font-weight:800;margin:13px 0 22px}
.start-teacher .dot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);flex:none}
.start-student-label{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:1000;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:8px}
.start-student-input{width:100%;border:2px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:17px;padding:15px 16px;font:inherit;font-size:20px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);outline:none;box-shadow:0 5px 12px rgba(44,52,67,.05);transition:.16s ease}
.start-student-input::placeholder{color:#a1a9b7;font-weight:700}
.start-student-input:focus{border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 5px var(--accent-soft)}
.start-help{margin:8px 0 18px;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;line-height:1.45}
.start-submit{width:100%;justify-content:center;font-size:14px;padding:15px 20px}
.start-submit:disabled{opacity:.48;cursor:not-allowed;transform:none;box-shadow:none}
@keyframes dialogFade{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
@keyframes dialogCardIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px) scale(.98)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
/* Cover */
.cover{min-height:calc(100vh - 110px);display:grid;place-items:center;padding:28px 0}
.cover-card{width:min(980px,100%);background:rgba(255,253,248,.94);border:1px solid rgba(234,223,206,.9);border-radius:38px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:42px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.cover-card:before,.cover-card:after{content:"";position:absolute;border-radius:50%;opacity:.55;pointer-events:none}
.cover-card:before{width:290px;height:290px;background:#ffe5bd;right:-115px;top:-135px}
.cover-card:after{width:220px;height:220px;background:#dff1ff;left:-110px;bottom:-105px}
.cover-inner{position:relative;z-index:1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.02fr .98fr;gap:42px;align-items:center}
.kicker{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 13px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.03em;text-transform:uppercase}
.cover h1{font-size:clamp(40px,5.6vw,68px);line-height:.96;letter-spacing:-.045em;margin:15px 0 13px}
.home-greeting{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:0 0 10px;padding:8px 13px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff0ee;border:1px solid #f5cbc6;color:var(--accent);font-size:14px;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:.01em}
.home-greeting:before{content:"👋";font-size:15px}
.home-greeting[hidden]{display:none}
.library-greeting{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--accent);font-size:14px;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase}
.library-greeting:before{content:"👋";font-size:15px}
.library-greeting[hidden]{display:none}
.cover h1 .accent{color:var(--accent)}
.cover p{font-size:17px;line-height:1.58;color:var(--muted);max-width:560px;margin:0 0 24px}
.teacher-line{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;color:var(--ink);font-size:14px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:22px}
.teacher-line .dot{width:10px;height:10px;background:var(--accent);border-radius:50%}
.primary-btn{border:0;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:14px 21px;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 12px 24px rgba(39,50,71,.18);transition:.18s ease}
.primary-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 15px 30px rgba(39,50,71,.21)}
.secondary-btn{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border-radius:14px;padding:11px 16px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;transition:.18s ease}
.secondary-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);background:#fffaf5}
.hero-alphabet{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:11px;transform:rotate(-2deg)}
.hero-letter{aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:20px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:1000;font-size:30px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm)}
.hero-letter:nth-child(4n+1){transform:translateY(9px)}
.hero-letter:nth-child(4n+2){transform:translateY(-6px)}
.hero-letter:nth-child(4n+3){transform:translateY(5px)}
.cover-note{margin-top:18px;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}
.credit-stack{display:grid;gap:14px;margin:0 0 24px;max-width:610px}
.credit-label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase}
.credit-label:before{content:"";width:28px;height:4px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--accent)}
.made-by-card{padding:20px 22px;border:2px solid #efd6cf;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff4f1,#fff);border-radius:24px;box-shadow:0 12px 26px rgba(44,52,67,.09);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.made-by-card:after{content:"✦";position:absolute;right:18px;top:4px;color:#f5b4aa;font-size:48px;transform:rotate(12deg)}
.made-by-card .made-by-title{font-size:14px;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:6px}
.made-by-card .made-by-name{font-size:clamp(42px,5.6vw,68px);font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:-.045em;line-height:.98}
.school-credit{display:grid;grid-template-columns:88px 1fr;gap:15px;align-items:center;margin:0;padding:13px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.9);border-radius:22px;box-shadow:0 9px 19px rgba(44,52,67,.07);max-width:610px}
.school-logo{width:88px;height:88px;object-fit:contain;flex:none;border-radius:16px;background:#fff}
.school-credit-copy{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;min-width:0}
.school-credit-item{padding:13px 14px;border-radius:16px;background:#faf7f0;border:1px solid var(--line);min-width:0}
.school-credit-item .label{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:.11em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:6px}
.school-credit-item strong{display:block;font-size:clamp(23px,2.6vw,31px);line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.school-credit-item.section strong{color:var(--accent)}
.intro-side-note{margin:12px 2px 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;font-weight:800}
/* Shared header */
.page-header{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;margin:10px 0 18px}
.page-header h2{margin:0;font-size:clamp(28px,4vw,42px);letter-spacing:-.035em}
.page-header p{margin:7px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px}
.progress-pill{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);padding:9px 12px;border-radius:999px;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap}
.subnav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-bottom:14px}
.subnav .back{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:13px;padding:10px 13px;font-size:13px;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink)}
.subnav .context{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.letter-chip{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:13px;background:var(--accent);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:21px;font-weight:1000;box-shadow:0 8px 15px rgba(50,60,80,.14)}
/* Learning sections */
.section-tabs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;margin:0 0 18px}
.section-tab{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:20px;padding:15px 16px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;transition:.18s ease}
.section-tab:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.section-tab .tab-icon{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:14px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#fff7eb;font-size:23px;flex:none}
.section-tab strong{display:block;font-size:14px}.section-tab span span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;margin-top:3px;line-height:1.3}
.section-tab.alphabet .tab-icon{background:#fff0ee}.section-tab.cvc .tab-icon{background:#edf5ff}.section-tab.sight .tab-icon{background:#f1efff}
.section-tabs-note{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;margin:-7px 0 14px}
/* Alphabet selector */
.select-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 300px;gap:20px;align-items:start}
.selector-card,.side-card{background:rgba(255,255,255,.88);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:26px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm)}
.selector-card{padding:20px}
.alphabet-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,minmax(0,1fr));gap:11px}
.letter-card{position:relative;min-width:0;aspect-ratio:1;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:18px;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 7px 16px rgba(44,52,67,.07);transition:.18s ease;padding:8px}
.letter-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 12px 22px rgba(44,52,67,.11)}
.letter-card .big{font-size:clamp(26px,4.2vw,38px);font-weight:1000;line-height:1}
.letter-card .small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;font-weight:800;margin-top:6px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.letter-card .mini-progress{position:absolute;left:8px;right:8px;bottom:8px;height:5px;background:#f0eadf;border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden}
.letter-card .mini-progress i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:inherit;width:0;background:var(--accent)}
.letter-card .mini-badge{position:absolute;top:7px;right:7px;font-size:11px}
.side-card{padding:20px;position:sticky;top:16px}
.side-card h3{margin:0 0 9px;font-size:18px}
.side-card p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;line-height:1.55}
.big-progress{margin:18px 0 15px;height:12px;background:#f0eadf;border-radius:999px;overflow:hidden}
.big-progress i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),var(--accent-2));border-radius:inherit}
.stat-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px}
.stat{background:#fffaf4;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:15px;padding:12px}
.stat strong{display:block;font-size:22px}
.stat span{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:800;margin-top:3px}
.side-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.tiny-note{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5;margin-top:12px}
.cvc-launch{margin-top:20px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fffaf0,#f1f7ff);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:26px;padding:20px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px}
.cvc-launch-copy{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.cvc-launch-icon{width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:17px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:28px;box-shadow:0 7px 14px rgba(44,52,67,.07);flex:none}
.cvc-launch h3{margin:0 0 5px;font-size:19px}
.cvc-launch p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;line-height:1.5}
.family-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:13px}
.family-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:21px;padding:17px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);transition:.18s ease;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.family-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 14px 28px rgba(44,52,67,.11)}
.family-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}
.family-pattern{font-size:34px;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:-.04em;color:var(--accent)}
.family-count{font-size:10px;font-weight:1000;color:var(--muted);background:#faf7f0;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 8px}
.family-sub{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.45;margin:3px 0 12px}
.family-words{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px}
.family-word{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fffaf4;color:var(--ink);border-radius:999px;padding:7px 9px;font-size:12px;font-weight:1000;cursor:pointer}
.family-word:hover{background:var(--accent-soft);border-color:transparent;color:var(--accent)}
.family-actions{display:flex;gap:7px;margin-top:13px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.family-game{margin-top:18px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:26px;padding:20px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);display:none}
.family-game.show{display:block}
.family-game h3{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:20px}
.family-game p{margin:0 0 14px;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}
.family-choice-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:9px;justify-content:center}
.family-choice{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fffaf4;border-radius:14px;padding:11px 15px;font-size:17px;font-weight:1000;cursor:pointer}
.family-choice.correct{background:var(--good-soft);border-color:#9fdbbb}
.family-choice.wrong{background:var(--bad-soft);border-color:#efb2b2}
/* Letter hub */
.letter-hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:145px 1fr;gap:20px;align-items:center;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:26px;padding:18px 20px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);margin-bottom:18px}
.hero-letter-big{height:145px;border-radius:24px;background:var(--accent-soft);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:94px;font-weight:1000;color:var(--accent);border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.04)}
.letter-hero h3{margin:0;font-size:26px;letter-spacing:-.025em}
.letter-hero p{margin:7px 0 13px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.55;font-size:14px}
.hero-meta{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.meta-chip{padding:7px 10px;background:#faf7f0;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;color:var(--muted)}
.activity-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:13px}
.activity-card{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:21px;padding:17px;cursor:pointer;text-align:left;min-height:154px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);transition:.18s ease;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.activity-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 14px 28px rgba(44,52,67,.11)}
.activity-icon{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--accent-soft);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:22px}
.activity-card h4{margin:11px 0 5px;font-size:15px}
.activity-card p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;line-height:1.45}
.activity-bottom{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:13px;gap:8px}
.dots{display:flex;gap:4px}
.dots i{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#e6dfd4}
.dots i.on{background:var(--accent)}
.play-tag{font-size:10px;font-weight:900;color:var(--accent)}
/* Activity shell */
.activity-shell{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:27px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);padding:20px;min-height:590px}
.activity-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;margin-bottom:15px}
.activity-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px}
.activity-title .icon{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--accent-soft);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:23px}
.activity-title h3{margin:0;font-size:22px}
.activity-title p{margin:3px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}
.activity-main{min-height:470px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.game-hud{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;width:min(620px,100%);gap:12px;margin-bottom:12px;font-weight:900;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.goal{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:#faf6ef;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:9px 12px;font-size:12px;color:var(--ink);font-weight:900;margin-bottom:14px}
.celebrate-card{display:none;text-align:center;background:#fffaf0;border:1px solid #f2dfb5;border-radius:21px;padding:21px;margin-top:14px;max-width:560px}
.celebrate-card.show{display:block;animation:pop .35s ease}
@keyframes pop{0%{transform:scale(.93);opacity:0}100%{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}}
.stars{font-size:23px;letter-spacing:3px;margin-bottom:7px}
.celebrate-card h4{margin:0 0 7px;font-size:18px}
.celebrate-card p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
.action-row{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:16px}
.game-btn{border:0;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;border-radius:14px;padding:11px 15px;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer}
.game-btn.alt{background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.game-btn.accent{background:var(--accent)}
/* Learn */
.learn-grid{width:min(720px,100%);display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}
.word-card{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fffdfb;border-radius:19px;padding:15px 8px;min-height:170px;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 7px 14px rgba(44,52,67,.06);transition:.18s ease;text-align:center;position:relative}
.word-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.word-card.done{background:var(--good-soft);border-color:#bfe6d0}
.word-card .emoji{display:block;font-size:45px;margin:4px 0 9px}
.word-card .word{font-size:15px;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:.02em}
.word-card .hint{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:6px}
.word-card .check{position:absolute;top:8px;right:8px;width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;display:none;place-items:center;background:var(--good);color:#fff;font-size:12px;font-weight:1000}
.word-card.done .check{display:grid}
/* Catch */
.catch-area{width:min(720px,100%);height:440px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#eaf7ff,#f6fcff);border:1px solid #cde7f7;border-radius:24px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.6)}
.catch-area:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:46px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,rgba(142,190,226,.16));pointer-events:none}
.falling-item{position:absolute;width:86px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;cursor:pointer;user-select:none;z-index:2;animation:drift linear forwards}
.falling-item .emoji{font-size:36px;line-height:1}
.falling-item .label{margin-top:5px;background:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(39,50,71,.08);border-radius:10px;padding:4px 7px;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;box-shadow:0 4px 8px rgba(39,50,71,.08);white-space:nowrap}
@keyframes drift{to{transform:translateY(480px)}}
.catch-start{margin-bottom:10px}
/* Trace + Color canvases */
.canvas-wrap{position:relative;width:min(430px,100%)}
canvas{display:block;max-width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:22px;touch-action:none}
.trace-canvas,.color-canvas,.dots-canvas{background:#fffdfa;border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm)}
.palette{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;margin:0 0 12px}
.swatch{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--line),0 5px 10px rgba(44,52,67,.10);cursor:pointer;transition:.15s ease}
.swatch.active{transform:scale(1.14);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--ink)}
/* Choose */
.listen-box{text-align:center}
.speaker-btn{width:78px;height:78px;border-radius:23px;border:0;background:var(--accent);color:#fff;font-size:33px;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 12px 24px rgba(50,60,80,.14);transition:.18s ease}
.speaker-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.prompt-word{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:800;margin:11px 0 15px}
.choose-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:14px;width:min(660px,100%)}
.choose-card{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:21px;padding:19px;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);transition:.18s ease}
.choose-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.choose-card .emoji{font-size:53px;display:block}
.choose-card .label{display:block;margin-top:9px;font-size:14px;font-weight:1000}
.choose-card.correct{border-color:#9fdbbb;background:var(--good-soft)}
.choose-card.wrong{border-color:#efb2b2;background:var(--bad-soft);animation:shake .24s}
@keyframes shake{25%{transform:translateX(-5px)}50%{transform:translateX(5px)}75%{transform:translateX(-4px)}}
/* Memory */
.memory-grid{width:min(610px,100%);display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}
.memory-card{aspect-ratio:1;border:0;background:#f1e9de;border-radius:17px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.7),0 7px 12px rgba(44,52,67,.07);cursor:pointer;position:relative;transform-style:preserve-3d;transition:transform .22s ease}
.memory-card.flipped,.memory-card.matched{transform:rotateY(180deg)}
.memory-card-face{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:inherit;backface-visibility:hidden}
.memory-card .front{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;font-size:26px;font-weight:1000}
.memory-card .back{background:#fff;transform:rotateY(180deg);padding:7px;text-align:center}
.memory-card .back .emoji{font-size:34px}
.memory-card .back .word{font-size:11px;font-weight:1000;margin-top:4px}
.memory-card.matched .back{background:var(--good-soft)}
/* Sort */
.sort-object{width:160px;height:160px;border-radius:27px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:65px;cursor:pointer;margin:4px 0 18px}
.sort-word{font-size:14px;font-weight:1000;margin-bottom:15px}
.basket-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(180px,1fr));gap:14px;width:min(560px,100%)}
.basket{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fffdfb;border-radius:20px;padding:18px;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);text-align:center;font-weight:1000;font-size:14px}
.basket .basket-icon{font-size:32px;display:block;margin-bottom:6px}
.basket.good{background:var(--accent-soft);border-color:rgba(0,0,0,.06)}
/* Hunt */
.hunt-grid{width:min(580px,100%);display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:9px}
.hunt-cell{aspect-ratio:1;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:16px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:28px;font-weight:1000;color:#44506a;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 7px 12px rgba(44,52,67,.06);transition:.14s}
.hunt-cell:hover{transform:scale(1.03)}
.hunt-cell.found{background:var(--good);color:#fff;border-color:var(--good);transform:scale(.96)}
.hunt-cell.wrong{background:var(--bad-soft);color:var(--bad);border-color:#efb2b2}
.hole{aspect-ratio:1;background:#6f4d3a;border-radius:50%;position:relative;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:inset 0 10px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.22),0 8px 14px rgba(44,52,67,.08)}
.mole{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:-96%;transform:translate(-50%,0);width:74%;height:74%;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:29px;font-weight:1000;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 8px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.14);transition:transform .16s ease}
.mole.up{transform:translate(-50%,-13%)}
.mole.target{background:var(--accent);color:#fff}
/* Build */
.build-emoji{font-size:64px;margin-bottom:12px}
.build-slots{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:16px}
.slot{width:58px;height:64px;border:2px dashed #ccbfae;background:#fff;border-radius:13px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:24px;font-weight:1000}
.slot.filled{border-style:solid;border-color:#99d4b3;background:var(--good-soft)}
.tiles{display:flex;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:9px;width:min(560px,100%)}
.tile{width:58px;height:64px;border:1px solid #efc28f;background:#fff4e6;border-radius:13px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:23px;font-weight:1000;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 7px 12px rgba(44,52,67,.07);transition:.16s}
.tile:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.tile.used{opacity:.28;pointer-events:none;transform:none}
/* Quiz */
.sequence{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:14px 0 20px}
.seq-box{width:62px;height:70px;border-radius:15px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:26px;font-weight:1000;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm)}
.seq-box.blank{border:2px dashed var(--accent);color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent-soft)}
.quiz-options{display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.quiz-option{width:70px;height:70px;border-radius:17px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:26px;font-weight:1000;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm)}
.quiz-option.correct{background:var(--good-soft);border-color:#9fdbbb}
.quiz-option.wrong{background:var(--bad-soft);border-color:#efb2b2}
/* CVC */
.cvc-grid{width:min(780px,100%);display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:13px}
.cvc-card{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fffdfb;border-radius:20px;padding:16px;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);transition:.18s}
.cvc-card:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.cvc-card.done{background:var(--good-soft);border-color:#bfe6d0}
.cvc-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:12px}
.cvc-tag{font-size:10px;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.cvc-speaker{border:0;background:#f5eee4;width:33px;height:33px;border-radius:11px;cursor:pointer}
.cvc-word{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:5px}
.cvc-letter{width:48px;height:56px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:23px;font-weight:1000}
.cvc-letter.target{border-color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent)}
.cvc-card.done .cvc-letter.target{background:var(--good);color:#fff;border-color:var(--good)}
.cvc-hint{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);text-align:center;margin-top:10px;line-height:1.35}
.cvc-note{margin-top:13px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);background:#faf7f0;border:1px solid var(--line);padding:9px 11px;border-radius:12px;max-width:700px;line-height:1.5;text-align:center}
/* Sight words */
.sight-word-strip{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;margin:3px 0 20px}
.sight-chip{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:15px;padding:12px 15px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);font-size:17px;font-weight:1000;cursor:pointer;transition:.16s}
.sight-chip:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);background:#fffaf5}
.sight-activity-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:13px}
.sight-activity{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:21px;padding:18px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);text-align:left}.sight-activity .icon{font-size:28px}.sight-activity h3{margin:10px 0 5px;font-size:17px}.sight-activity p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;line-height:1.45}.sight-activity button{margin-top:13px}
.sight-game{margin-top:16px;display:none;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:24px;padding:20px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm)}.sight-game.show{display:block}
.sight-prompt{font-size:24px;font-weight:1000;text-align:center;margin:8px 0 16px}.sight-sentence{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:15px 0}.sight-token{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fffaf4;border-radius:13px;padding:11px 14px;font-weight:1000;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 5px 10px rgba(44,52,67,.06)}.sight-token.target{background:var(--accent-soft);border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent)}
.sight-choices{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}.sight-choice{min-width:90px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:14px;padding:12px 16px;font-weight:1000;cursor:pointer}.sight-choice.correct{background:var(--good-soft);border-color:#9fdbbb}.sight-choice.wrong{background:var(--bad-soft);border-color:#efb2b2}
.builder-bank,.builder-target{min-height:62px;border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:10px;display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}.builder-bank{background:#faf7f0}.builder-target{background:#f8fbff}.builder-word{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:10px 13px;font-weight:1000;cursor:pointer}.builder-word.used{opacity:.3;pointer-events:none}.sentence-result{text-align:center;margin-top:14px;font-weight:1000;color:var(--good);font-size:16px;line-height:1.4;min-height:24px}
/* Certificate */
.certificate-form{max-width:560px;margin:0 auto 18px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.94);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:14px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm)}
.certificate-form label{display:block;font-size:11px;font-weight:1000;color:var(--muted);text-align:left;margin:0 0 7px;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase}
.certificate-form input{width:100%;border:2px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:14px;padding:12px 14px;font:inherit;font-size:16px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);outline:none;transition:.16s ease}
.certificate-form input:focus{border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--accent-soft)}
.certificate{width:min(980px,100%);aspect-ratio:1.56/1;margin:22px auto 0;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fffdf8 0%,#fffaf2 56%,#eef8ff 100%);border:7px solid #f5e5c7;border-radius:36px;box-shadow:0 22px 55px rgba(44,52,67,.15);padding:30px 34px 26px;text-align:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between}
.certificate:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:14px;border:2px solid rgba(231,191,106,.48);border-radius:28px;pointer-events:none;z-index:-1}
.certificate:after{content:"";position:absolute;width:310px;height:310px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,225,190,.62);right:-145px;top:-165px;z-index:-3}
.certificate-corner{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;z-index:-2}
.certificate-corner-blue{width:190px;height:190px;background:rgba(219,242,255,.80);left:-105px;bottom:-120px}
.certificate-corner-peach{width:120px;height:120px;background:rgba(255,220,199,.34);right:23%;top:-90px}
.certificate-brand{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;text-align:left;position:relative;z-index:2}
.certificate-school{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:15px;min-width:0}
.certificate-school-logo-box{width:104px;height:104px;border-radius:22px;background:#fff;border:2px solid #eadcc3;box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(44,52,67,.10);display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:hidden;padding:4px;flex:none}
.certificate-school-logo{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;object-fit:contain}
.certificate-school-copy{min-width:0}
.certificate-school-copy strong{display:block;font-size:22px;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.025em}
.certificate-school-copy span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;font-weight:900;line-height:1.3;margin-top:5px}
.certificate-app-name{align-self:flex-start;padding:11px 17px;border:1.5px solid #e4d4b6;background:rgba(255,255,255,.88);border-radius:999px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:.11em;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 8px 16px rgba(44,52,67,.05)}
.certificate-center{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:6px 12px 4px;position:relative;z-index:1}
.certificate-medal{font-size:58px;line-height:1;margin:0 0 4px;filter:drop-shadow(0 5px 4px rgba(44,52,67,.14))}
.certificate-eyebrow{font-size:12px;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:.17em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent);margin-top:5px}
.certificate h2{font-size:clamp(34px,4.4vw,52px);line-height:.98;letter-spacing:-.05em;margin:7px 0 4px}
.certificate .certificate-name{font-size:clamp(34px,4.6vw,56px);line-height:1.02;font-weight:1000;color:var(--ink);margin:4px 0 8px;letter-spacing:-.04em;max-width:92%;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.certificate p{color:var(--muted);max-width:650px;margin:0 auto;line-height:1.45;font-size:14px}
.certificate-bottom{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:22px;text-align:left;position:relative;z-index:2}
.certificate-stats-inline{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.certificate-mini-stat{min-width:136px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.86);border:1px solid #eadfce;border-radius:15px;padding:10px 12px;box-shadow:0 6px 14px rgba(44,52,67,.04)}
.certificate-mini-stat strong{display:block;font-size:20px;line-height:1.05;color:var(--accent)}
.certificate-mini-stat span{display:block;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:900;margin-top:4px}
.certificate-teacher{text-align:right}
.certificate-teacher .label{display:block;font-size:10px;font-weight:1000;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase}
.certificate-teacher strong{display:block;font-size:20px;line-height:1.1;margin-top:4px;color:var(--ink)}
.certificate-teacher .date{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px}
.certificate-print-note{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);text-align:center;margin-top:7px}
@media(max-width:760px){
.certificate{aspect-ratio:auto;min-height:680px;padding:24px 20px 22px;border-width:6px;border-radius:30px}
.certificate-brand{gap:14px}

}

.footer-note{margin-top:18px;text-align:center;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
/* Toast */
.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;top:22px;transform:translate(-50%,-120px);background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--shadow);border-radius:999px;padding:11px 17px;font-size:13px;font-weight:1000;z-index:9999;transition:.25s ease;white-space:nowrap}
.toast.show{transform:translate(-50%,0)}
.particle{position:fixed;pointer-events:none;z-index:9998;font-size:20px}
/* Compatibility fallback for Safari versions without Web Animations */
.compat-shake{animation:compatShake .22s ease}
@keyframes compatShake{25%{transform:translateX(-4px)}50%{transform:translateX(4px)}75%{transform:translateX(-3px)}100%{transform:none}}
/* Responsive */

.identity-card:before{content:"";position:absolute;right:-55px;top:-80px;width:165px;height:165px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,214,204,.42)}

.certificate-app-name{font-size:15px;padding:12px 20px;margin-bottom:3px}
.certificate .certificate-name{font-size:52px}
.certificate-letter-progress{margin-top:9px;padding:8px 12px}
.certificate-letter-chip{width:27px;height:27px;font-size:10px}
.certificate-letter-note{display:none}
}
/* Memory Match: larger, child-readable cards at every device size */
.memory-grid{width:min(760px,100%);display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}
.memory-card{min-width:0;min-height:100px;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:20px}
.memory-card .front{font-size:clamp(30px,4.2vw,40px);line-height:1}
.memory-card .back{padding:10px}
.memory-card .back .emoji{font-size:clamp(40px,5.2vw,52px);line-height:1}
.memory-card .back .word{font-size:clamp(17px,2vw,22px);line-height:1.05;font-weight:1000;margin-top:6px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
@media(max-width:900px){.memory-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:11px}}
@media(max-width:650px){.memory-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}.memory-card{min-height:92px}.memory-card .back .word{font-size:clamp(16px,3.6vw,20px)}}
@media(max-width:430px){.memory-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}.memory-card{min-height:112px}.memory-card .front{font-size:34px}.memory-card .back .emoji{font-size:46px}.memory-card .back .word{font-size:18px}}
@media(max-width:330px){.memory-grid{gap:8px}.memory-card{min-height:100px}.memory-card .back .word{font-size:16px}}
/* Certificate: keep the whole certificate visible and balanced on screen */
.certificate{display:grid;grid-template-rows:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:8px;width:min(1000px,100%);aspect-ratio:1.62/1;min-height:0;padding:24px 30px 20px}
.certificate-center{min-height:0;padding:2px 10px}
.certificate-letter-progress{width:min(780px,100%);padding:8px 12px 9px;margin:7px auto 0}
.certificate-letter-chips{gap:5px}
.certificate-letter-chip{width:30px;height:30px;font-size:12px}
@media(max-width:760px){.certificate{aspect-ratio:auto;min-height:660px;padding:20px 16px 18px}.certificate-letter-chip{width:28px;height:28px;font-size:11px}}
@media(max-width:500px){.certificate{min-height:725px;padding:17px 13px}.certificate-letter-chip{width:27px;height:27px;font-size:10px}}
@media print{.certificate{aspect-ratio:1.62/1;min-height:0;padding:20px 24px 18px}.certificate-letter-chip{width:27px;height:27px;font-size:10px}}
</style>
</head>
